query:
Oh my gosh, I just ran into the cutest golden retriever puppy on my way to grab coffee this morning, it rolled right onto its feet to nudge my hand for scratches and even dropped its little squeaky duck toy at my feet to play fetch for a minute. The barista at my usual spot also gave me a free extra shot of espresso today because they accidentally made an extra one for the person ahead of me who left already, that totally made my whole rainy afternoon way better. I was also just scrolling through my social media and saw the funniest cat video where the cat tried to jump onto a windowsill and slipped into a pile of laundry, I had to send it to all my friends right away.
Anyway, I need to cancel my pending order #W3189752 because the items are no longer needed, and for my other pending order #W5166363, could you modify the items? I want to swap item 3334537816 for item 3265035808, and use credit_card_4466831 as the payment method for that modified order, thanks!
